title: Run fresh-session clean-room release rehearsal
scope: Freeze the merged Temple revision, initialize one disposable new project through a fresh Codex task, complete one bounded Work Item, recover it from a second independent task, and record timing, errors, interventions, documentation gaps, and truthful usage availability without publishing or releasing.
acceptance_criteria: The first participant starts with no prior Temple conversation and uses only repository-visible instructions plus the frozen product brief.
A disposable project is initialized with project-specific identities, completes one bounded Work Item through accepted closeout, and ends with healthy Status and Doctor evidence.
A second independent Codex task recovers the project state, responsible Position, completed outcome, evidence, and next safe action without receiving the first task conversation.
The final report records elapsed time, errors, rework, Human interventions, documentation gaps, and available or unknown Token data without generalizing beyond this run.
No repository visibility, package version, npm state, tag, GitHub Release, announcement, purchase, reset, or automatic fallback changes.

profile_assessment.rationale: This is a bounded, reversible, local-only release-path rehearsal with a fixed stop condition and no publication authority.
